videos.title: Todas as IAs. Uma única memória.
videos.creator: @BRUNOBRACAIOLI
videos.summary: Video exploring a centralized unified memory database that all LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Ollama) can read from and write to, eliminating context fragmentation across multi-LLM systems.

RESUMEN.one_liner: Centralized memory database connecting all LLMs so knowledge is shared, not duplicated.
RESUMEN.key_insight: Current multi-LLM systems fragment knowledge; a single source of truth eliminates redundant learning and contradictions.
RESUMEN.main_topic: Unified Memory Architecture for Multi-LLM Systems
subtopics: Semantic retrieval via embeddings with confidence scoring

reasons: ARIA currently uses a single LLM backend and would benefit from multi-LLM shared memory
The 4-layer memory model (facts/patterns/insights/state) maps directly onto aura.db
LLM adapter pattern matches ARIA's existing ai_providers abstraction
Priority 1 schema work unblocks all future memory features

APLICABLE PARA ARIA AGENTS.specific_use_case: Design and implement ARIA's unified memory layer so all agents (Kilo, Cline, Claude Code) share learned insights across sessions and LLM backends.
action_items: Extend aura.db with memories table (id, type, content, embedding, confidence, source_llm, source_agent, expiry_at, tags)
Build aria_llm/adapter.py with LLMAdapter ABC and concrete adapters for Claude, ChatGPT, Ollama
Refactor aria_agents/agent_base.py to query memory before execution and store results after
Add /api/memory endpoints to control.rs (Rust Axum backend)
Implement soft-delete and access logging for retention policies

videos.title: I built my own multiverse. Seven universes. One system.
videos.creator: @MASSIVE.MANAS.EXE
videos.summary: Video showing a 7-universe multiverse architecture with a central NEXUS hub coordinating independent logical domains (ADMIN, CODING, MEDIA, KNOWLEDGE, INTEGRATION, UI/UX, NEXUSVERSE). Each universe has its own agents, color, and resource profile, communicating only through the central hub.

RESUMEN.one_liner: Seven independent universes coordinated by a central NEXUS — logical domains, not separate systems.
RESUMEN.key_insight: Grouping agents by domain (admin/coding/media/knowledge) with hub-routed communication gives isolation without fragmentation.
RESUMEN.main_topic: Multiverse Architecture: Seven Specialized Workspaces Under One NEXUS
subtopics: Universe registry with color-coded domains and agent assignment
NEXUS router for cross-universe communication (A → NEXUS → B, never direct)
Universe Navigator UI with orbit visualization
Alt+[1-7] keyboard shortcuts for instant universe switching

reasons: ARIA already has the concept of universes in snapshots and memory — this video makes it visual and navigable
NEXUS routing pattern matches ARIA's existing control.rs dispatch logic
Per-universe resource limits solve the 'agents fight for resources' problem
Backward compatible: default universe = DEFAULT for existing tasks

APLICABLE PARA ARIA AGENTS.specific_use_case: Implement ARIA's multiverse architecture so agents are grouped into 7 domain universes (ADMIN, CODING, MEDIA, KNOWLEDGE, INTEGRATION, UI/UX, NEXUS) with hub-routed communication, per-universe resource limits, and a visual navigator.
action_items: Create aria_multiverse/universe_registry.py with Universe dataclass (id, name, color, agents, resources)
Create aria_multiverse/router.py with UniverseRouter for NEXUS-based cross-universe communication
Add universes table to aura.db (id, name, color, icon, parent_universe, isolated, max_tasks, max_memory_mb, cpu_share, timeout_seconds)
Modify task.py to add universe_id field and queue.py to filter agents by universe
Create v5/src/components/UniverseNavigator.tsx with orbit visualization and Alt+[1-7] shortcuts
Implement UniverseResources dataclass with per-universe limits (concurrency, memory, timeout, cpu_share)
